name: Hemam
title: Descendant of Seir the Horite
summary: Hemam was a son of Lotan, who was a son of Seir the Horite. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles as part of the original inhabitants of Edom's land, the Horites, who lived in the mountains of Seir before the Edomites took over the area.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Seir's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Hemam is mentioned as a son of Lotan, the firstborn son of Seir, in the genealogy of the Horite chiefs who lived in the land of Seir.

keyEvents.title: Genealogical Line of the Horite Chiefs
keyEvents.description: Hemam belonged to the original Horite peoples who inhabited the mountains of Seir before Esau's descendants drove them out.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: In 1 Chronicles, the genealogy is repeated, where Hemam is referred to as Homam, a variant of the name, as the son of Lotan.

keyEvents.title: Timna as Lotan's sister
keyEvents.description: In connection with Hemam's family, it is mentioned that Timna was Lotan's sister, she who became the concubine of Esau's son Eliphaz and mother of Amalek.
